id: title:Gilbert09:send the staged value as incoming on the wire

review.posthog_relevance: Credentials Service API response and documentation
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F7.H1 shows a wire protocol field name change from 'previous' to 'incoming' in the Credentials Service, while retaining the staged value internally. This removes an intentional mismatch between wire and implementation, potentially preventing downstream consumers from relying on a deprecated field and clarifying rotation state. review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and relevant checks are not fully visible; the benefit relies on the removal of a temporary mismatch rather than a demonstrated systemic improvement. No tests or broader context are provided to verify downstream compatibility or recovery behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; only observations are collected.

observations.behavior: The wire protocol field name is renamed from 'previous' to 'incoming' in the Credentials Service, while the internal Python model retains the staged value. This removes the intentional mismatch and propagates the corrected wire name.
observations.posthog_connection: This change updates the Credentials Service API response and documentation, removing the temporary wire-field mismatch. It could prevent downstream consumers from relying on a field named 'previous' while the implementation expects 'incoming', and could help clarify the rotation state.
